sections.overall: Spring Break '26 proved to be a mini PPV in terms of match quality, big stakes and moments. It was also rated over 9 - one of the best Dynamites this year! The one match everyone is talking about of course is Kenny Omega's World Title win. His main event against MJF was the best of their trilogy (9.17) and a twist to the assumed All In plans. MJF also reaches a career all time peak! What a year AEW is having!
sections.mens: The other big Men's Division match on Dynamite was the International Title between Kyle Fletcher and Konosuke Takeshita. Although well-received (8.36), the expectations were so high for these "gold" tier wrestlers, it meant few rating points were gained. An even better match was Mark Davis's defense of the National Title against Mike Bailey to headline Collision (8.7). Davis's best ever and the strongest for Bailey since March! Other decent matches: Tommaso Ciampa vs Chris Jericho and Bandido vs Katsuyori Shibata were almost forgotten in such a star-studded week!
sections.womens: Welcome back Willow Nightingale! Her surprise return in the Casino Gauntlet, and new Number 1 contender status, has shaken up the Women's Division. Harley Cameron showed her best singles outing for a while in her TBS Title loss to Hikaru Shida (5.66)
sections.menstag: The only tag match this week was the disappointing Moxley & Ospreay vs The WorkHorsemen match (5.48). Although it didn't hurt their Tag rating, both Jon and Will's Men's rankings have suffered as a result.
sections.womenstag: How many times have we been here before? With only two teams now active in the division, roll on next week where the champs will feature at least!
sections.trios: No Trios matches this week. The division is looking quite barren at the moment. Hopefully new challengers for the champs will establish themselves soon.
